kindNotes: modal.slice-end.record: the root has no data-frame (a container: its own border and the 8 px gap)

slot.ledger.rights.data: chapter 4's rights register (charter rights, fee farm, revolt pressure)

slot.ledger.rights-decline.data: chapter 2's register after a right is lost

modal.pause.data: the pause menu and its settings

modal.lord.home-petition.data: the boundary dispute (Wave 44 01) in the DEC-CARD layout: the situation, the stake, each answer now / later / who remembers

modal.lord.home-petition.guardian.data: a minor lord's wardship petition (the court line with his guardian)

modal.lord.request.data: the town's request (a proclamation waiting) in the DEC-CARD layout: the grant's now (the works it opens) and later (the actual's day)

modal.lord.registry.data: the first v4 offer the registry drew in the lord's slice (DEC-CARD layout): its why, each answer's tradeoff, now / later / who remembers, the shut one with why

modal.lord.registry-hold.data: the first v4 offer with a hold the lord can choose (DEC-CARD layout): the hold's cost as the engine's run shows it (the claim weakened)

lord.receipt.data: a town-built farmstead's receipt: five reasons, the next best site, the chance, the 10d subsidy and its decisions

lord.receipt-old.data: the same receipt from a save before the chance was kept

lord.receipt-none.data: the opening well: no receipt, the reason instead of an empty frame

lord.receipt-inspector.data: the first store's receipt (or why it has none) from the left inspector

lord.screen.data: the lord screen host over the town: the left menu (each shut item with its reason) and the screen (empty until an area opens one)

lord.negotiation.draft.data: the marriage offer before any is sent: the grooms, the clause editor, the draft treaty (consent alone), the counterpart's tier and reasons, the refusal (no terms) under a shut offer button

lord.negotiation.counter.data: the counterpart's counter waiting a season: the clauses with the one it added marked, its tier and reasons, the deadline and what silence means, each answer's now / later / who remembers (DEC-CARD), accept and refuse as equal choices

lord.negotiation.treaty.data: the drawn treaty sheet on the counter's page: its clause rows within it

lord.negotiation.row.data: one drawn clause row of the treaty: its words within the row

lord.negotiation.reason.data: one drawn reason of the counterpart's tier: its words within it

lord.negotiation.will-change.data: the marriage's progress with the will change due: the events as they fell, the deferred debt, the engine's deadline as a season and the decide button to the will's card (SUIT-THREAD: where the will's chip opens), the contract's clauses under a stamped seal

lord.negotiation.contested.data: the estate contested after the will stood: the rival named, the outcome, the way to its suit on the ledger screen

lord.ledger.promises.data: the promise ledger with kept, broken and open debt instalments (the lord keeps them from the treasury), the lord's open claim

lord.ledger.book.data: the promise book's drawn page inside the ledger: the promises' lines within it

lord.ledger.track.data: the suit's drawn stage track inside the ledger: the stages within it

lord.ledger.empty.data: no promise yet (the marriage only offered): the empty ledger's lines, no timed terms, the lord's claim with its filing button (PLAY-2: its cost, the hearing's sides)

lord.ledger.suit.data: the contested inheritance's suit just filed: the stage track, the hearing's two sides, the five evidence kinds to bring; two claims to file

lord.ledger.neighbour.data: the lord's two closed suits (judged, enforced) and a neighbour's recovery suit against him just filed, with his defence (SUIT-THREAD: evidence, the concord's two terms, the hold shut with its stage)

lord.ledger.defence-enforcing.data: a house's suit against the lord judged for it, its enforcement under way: the lord's hold with its cost, the concord at the whole price

lord.ledger.entry-threat.data: a forcible entry forewarned by a house past −60 (1344): the guard and the gift at the engine's costs, the engine's sentence

lord.ledger.entry-forced.data: the house came in by force: the lord's novel claim (a suit for the possession taken by force) with its filing cost and hearing, the entry in the engine's words

lord.estates.home.data: the estates screen on the home estate: the totals, the attention, the four estates to choose, the home card with its pieces and grants, the exceptions, the petitions

lord.estates.card.data: the home estate's card in its record frame: its pieces and grants within the frame

lord.estates.delegated.data: the inherited estate given to the greedy steward: its card with the overlay, the steward and the two other candidates, the audit by visit, its first season

lord.estates.overloaded.data: the same estate taken direct while a visit's year lowers the attention: load 2 over capacity 1, the warning, the receiver, three seasons

lord.estates.audit-pending.data: a visit's audit waiting for the lord's answer: what it found and the days left (the answer is the decision card's)

lord.region.data: the region map on the inherited state: the home direct, the inherited estate delegated to its steward (chosen, its line under the map), two neighbours; the map fitted

lord.region.zoomed.data: the region map at full zoom on the neighbour-suit state: the first neighbour chosen (its flag a neighbour's, the pieces the lord won of it listed), the map scrolled to it

hud.event-card.will-kept.data: the father's new will as its chip's card: the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the lord screen's marriage page

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

hud.event-card.suit-defence.data: a neighbour house's suit against the lord: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the suit in the ledger

hud.event-card.entry-threat.data: a house's forcible entry forewarned: the engine's warning, the season it comes, the button to the warning in the ledger

modal.lord.contested.data: the contested inheritance: the rival's hold, both claims' strength, the lord's suit stage, the way to the suit

modal.lord.audit.data: a Michaelmas audit's finding: punish, replace, tolerate — what each recovers, who follows, who remembers

modal.lord.offmap-petition.data: an off-map estate's petition: why it came to the lord, both answers' treasury and the estate's goodwill

lord.standing.data: the standing policies: the manor's twelve petitions (with the all-to-the-lord switch, rules.recurring), the off-map estates' six, the senders' five, each with its setting

lord.standing.kind.data: the heriot opened: the four settings (all secondary, the one in force pressed) and what each would do, this year's count

modal.season-ledger.steward.data: a lord-mode season close with the steward's section: what he handled by which policy (each a drill-in), the money and factions, what he brought

hud.auto-pause.data: time run in the lord slice until the engine names a reason (the first, a great person's death): why it stopped, the ledger's line and the way on

hud.auto-pause.link.data: time run until a suit is judged: the judgment's line with the way to its suit on the ledger screen beside the way on

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-041.data: the pannage petition on the woodland in autumn in 041's words (the longest variant body)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-048.data: the common-pasture petition in 048's words (the commons against the second merchant house)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-056.data: the road and bridge petition beside the market in 056's words

modal.lord.registry.variant-067.data: 031's steward offer in 067's words (ability against loyalty; the longest variant title)

modal.lord.registry.variant-078.data: 019's oversight offer in 078's words (the merchant's man against the peasants')

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off

modal.slice-end.data: the slice's end in 1317 (seed 3, five years after the second estate of 1312; ~/fls-slice-end-states rebuilt on the TRACE-KEEP engine): the last year 1316 at the top with its two cards as links, why and when, then and now with the maps, the decisions ranked by what followed, who remembers, a line a year with its big decisions from the thread (1300-1308 too) and what followed each, and its small matters counted in one line

modal.slice-end.record.data: the end page's first decision (1300's market dues, 67 rows followed) opened in the chronicle on its record (closing it comes back to the page)

modal.slice-end.season-card.data: 1316 winter's season card (the last closed before the end in 1317 spring) opened from the end page's link (it does not open by itself at the end)
